name: MVP 29.0 – Proposal Generator

features: Adds documented nested CLI command: proposal-queue add
Adds CLI contract selftest: python main.py selftest cli
Adds API route selftest: python main.py selftest api
Adds combined integration selftest: python main.py selftest integration
Validates documented MVP 28.x CLI aliases for Genome, Evolution Factory, Observation, Pattern, Priority and Proposal Queue
Proposal Queue add uses Evolution Factory and remains review-only
tests: python main.py proposal-queue add --type TOOL --title "Test Tool Proposal" --priority MEDIUM
